name: What's the difference between replacement windows and new construction windows?
description: Replacement windows fit existing openings without structural changes, while new construction windows have nailing fins for direct attachment to framing.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between replacement windows and new construction windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacement windows are designed to fit into an existing window opening without altering the original frame structure, often used for remodels. New construction windows include a nailing fin that attaches directly to the home's framing, typically used when building a new home or expanding an existing opening. Your project type dictates which style is appropriate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacement windows fit existing openings without structural changes, while new construction windows have nailing fins for direct attachment to framing.
